subject: Amendment required to draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading and found discrepancies against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference.

The Consignee is listed as UAB NOVAKOPA on the draft Bill of Lading, but the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC.

Additionally, the Notify Party is listed as UAB NOVAKOPA on the draft Bill of Lading, but the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC.

Please amend the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Shipping Operations
